review.basis: Fresh original GitHub criteria, actual code/Reference/stdlib and Git diff, preserved actual logs/source maps and terminal hosted integration. The earlier criterion-review.json is an index, not assumed evidence.
review.verdict: All fourteen original implementation criteria satisfied and evidenced; no remaining required implementation gap found.
review.authority: Ordinary implementation review only. No human Guardian judgment, interpretation adoption, guarantee admission or mathematical discharge is supplied.

criteria.text: The Language Reference states that ordinary checked `.qli` effects are derived from the body by the normative checker.
criteria.finding: Body/callee effects are normative and derive through both typed consumers.

criteria.text: Effect inference is deterministic and uniquely determined under #100.
criteria.finding: Ordered joins and the least monotone sized solution follow termination checking; all six declaration-order permutations retain principal facts.

criteria.text: A handwritten effect annotation on an ordinary body cannot manufacture semantic authority.
criteria.finding: Checked inferred/asserted facts never seed inference with a prefix.

criteria.text: If explicit annotations remain, their assertion/checking semantics are specified.
criteria.finding: Unitary <= Iso <= Observe optional upper-bound assertions preserve principal facts.

criteria.text: An annotation cannot hide or downgrade `Observe`.
criteria.finding: Direct/transitive/internal observation contradictions reject; text/JSON source and host diagnostics identify unsupported external justification.

criteria.text: The current derived stdlib is audited for redundant hand-written effect contracts.
criteria.finding: Every current derived source is audited: ten runtime functions and three basis definitions.

criteria.text: Redundant stdlib effect annotations are removed or converted into checked assertions rather than trusted declarations.
criteria.finding: Historical diff removes seven unitary and three observe prefixes, retaining bodies and mathematical comments.

criteria.text: `qlidoc` / interface metadata can expose inferred effect classes without requiring duplicate source annotations.
criteria.finding: Immutable checked ProjectEffects/ParsedProgram facts and rendering expose principal class and assertion from retained source; source-only documentation remains unverified.

criteria.text: Exact mathematical `Meaning` specifications remain distinguished from mechanically inferred effect classification.
criteria.finding: Reference/rendering distinguish effect class from exact Meaning/access/preservation; independent mathematical comments remain.

criteria.text: Anything that genuinely requires trusted semantic authority is classified under the primitive boundary of #167/#154, not ordinary stdlib.
criteria.finding: Existing sealed catalogs and admission rules remain unchanged; no primitive is introduced.

criteria.text: No ordinary stdlib function gains privileged effect authority because of its module/path/name.
criteria.finding: Bundled derived bodies follow ordinary checking; misleading names/module placements and std injection are tested.

criteria.text: #152's later structural refactor consumes these checked/inferred contracts without redefining them.
criteria.finding: The future #152 consumer contract requires immutable inferred facts and source identity while retaining later structural scope.

criteria.text: **`externally unitary` / `externally isometry` are explicitly left unresolved and deferred to the long-term post-v1 work in #283.**
criteria.finding: The original decision and Reference explicitly retain unsupported external justification and unresolved post-v1 #283.

criteria.text: No 0.3.0 escape hatch is introduced that approximates the future #283 mechanism.
criteria.finding: Source/provider/host checks consume principal facts, with independent shape/owner/access/native checks and no external-certificate bypass.
